implement_retirement_reason.name: implement_retirement_reason
implement_retirement_reason.value: ("contracting"."implement"."retired_at" IS NULL AND "contracting"."implement"."retired_reason" IS NULL) OR ("contracting"."implement"."retired_at" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("contracting"."implement"."retired_reason")) > 0 AND "contracting"."implement"."retired_reason" IS NOT NULL)

machine_retirement_reason.name: machine_retirement_reason
machine_retirement_reason.value: ("contracting"."machine"."retired_at" IS NULL AND "contracting"."machine"."retired_reason" IS NULL) OR ("contracting"."machine"."retired_at" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("contracting"."machine"."retired_reason")) > 0 AND "contracting"."machine"."retired_reason" IS NOT NULL)

documents_exactly_one_owner.name: documents_exactly_one_owner
documents_exactly_one_owner.value: ("equipment"."documents"."owner_type" = 'product' AND "equipment"."documents"."product_id" IS NOT NULL AND "equipment"."documents"."job_id" IS NULL AND "equipment"."documents"."quote_id" IS NULL AND "equipment"."documents"."purchase_order_id" IS NULL) OR ("equipment"."documents"."owner_type" = 'job' AND "equipment"."documents"."job_id" IS NOT NULL AND "equipment"."documents"."product_id" IS NULL AND "equipment"."documents"."quote_id" IS NULL AND "equipment"."documents"."purchase_order_id" IS NULL) OR ("equipment"."documents"."owner_type" = 'quote' AND "equipment"."documents"."quote_id" IS NOT NULL AND "equipment"."documents"."product_id" IS NULL AND "equipment"."documents"."job_id" IS NULL AND "equipment"."documents"."purchase_order_id" IS NULL) OR ("equipment"."documents"."owner_type" = 'purchase_order' AND "equipment"."documents"."purchase_order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "equipment"."documents"."product_id" IS NULL AND "equipment"."documents"."job_id" IS NULL AND "equipment"."documents"."quote_id" IS NULL)

invoice_flag_resolution_shape.name: invoice_flag_resolution_shape
invoice_flag_resolution_shape.value: ("equipment"."invoice_flag_resolution"."kind" = 'applied' AND "equipment"."invoice_flag_resolution"."stock_movement_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("equipment"."invoice_flag_resolution"."kind" = 'dismissed' AND "equipment"."invoice_flag_resolution"."stock_movement_id" IS NULL)

feedback_subject_exactly_one.name: feedback_subject_exactly_one
feedback_subject_exactly_one.value:
("equipment"."feedback"."subject_type" = 'quote' AND "equipment"."feedback"."quote_id" IS NOT NULL AND "equipment"."feedback"."job_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("equipment"."feedback"."subject_type" = 'job' AND "equipment"."feedback"."job_id" IS NOT NULL AND "equipment"."feedback"."quote_id" IS NULL)

job_slot_work_job_required_idle_job_forb.name: job_slot_work_job_required_idle_job_forbidden
job_slot_work_job_required_idle_job_forb.value: ("equipment"."job_slot"."kind" = 'work' AND "equipment"."job_slot"."job_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("equipment"."job_slot"."kind" = 'idle' AND "equipment"."job_slot"."job_id" IS NULL)

job_close_out_candidate_idx.name: job_close_out_candidate_idx
job_close_out_candidate_idx.where: "equipment"."job"."completed_on" IS NOT NULL AND "equipment"."job"."cancelled_at" IS NULL

job_cancellation_reason_shape.name: job_cancellation_reason_shape
job_cancellation_reason_shape.value: "equipment"."job"."cancellation_reason" IS NULL OR ("equipment"."job"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("equipment"."job"."cancellation_reason")) > 0)

job_product_unit_or_quote_required.name: job_product_unit_or_quote_required
job_product_unit_or_quote_required.value: "equipment"."job"."product_unit_id" IS NOT NULL OR "equipment"."job"."quote_id" IS NOT NULL OR "equipment"."job"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL

parts_standard_purchase_length_mm_unit_c.name: parts_standard_purchase_length_mm_unit_check
parts_standard_purchase_length_mm_unit_c.value: ("equipment"."parts"."unit_of_measure" = 'mm' AND "equipment"."parts"."standard_purchase_length_mm" IS NOT NULL) OR ("equipment"."parts"."unit_of_measure" <> 'mm' AND "equipment"."parts"."standard_purchase_length_mm" IS NULL)

parts_supplier_or_bom.name: parts_supplier_or_bom
parts_supplier_or_bom.value: ("equipment"."parts"."is_internally_fabricated" AND "equipment"."parts"."supplier_id" IS NULL) OR (NOT "equipment"."parts"."is_internally_fabricated" AND "equipment"."parts"."supplier_id" IS NOT NULL)

product_assemblies_price_kind_check.name: product_assemblies_price_kind_check
product_assemblies_price_kind_check.value: ("equipment"."product_assemblies"."kind" = 'standard' AND "equipment"."product_assemblies"."price" IS NULL) OR ("equipment"."product_assemblies"."kind" = 'optional' AND "equipment"."product_assemblies"."price" IS NOT NULL)

purchase_order_amendment_shape.name: purchase_order_amendment_shape
purchase_order_amendment_shape.value:
(
        "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."kind" = 'quantity-change'
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."part_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."new_part_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."new_quantity" IS NOT NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."old_quantity" IS NOT NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."old_expected_date" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."new_expected_date" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."kind" = 'add-line'
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."part_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."new_part_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."new_quantity" IS NOT NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."old_quantity" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."old_expected_date" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."new_expected_date" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."kind" = 'substitute-part'
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."part_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."new_part_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."new_part_id" <> "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."part_id"
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."new_quantity" IS NOT NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."old_quantity" IS NOT NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."old_expected_date" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."new_expected_date" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."kind" = 'expected-date-change'
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."part_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."new_part_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."new_quantity" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."old_quantity" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."purchase_order_amendment"."new_expected_date" IS NOT NULL
      )

purchase_order_sent_at_shape.name: purchase_order_sent_at_shape
purchase_order_sent_at_shape.value: ("equipment"."purchase_order"."status" IN ('draft', 'approved') AND "equipment"."purchase_order"."sent_at" IS NULL) OR ("equipment"."purchase_order"."status" = 'sent' AND "equipment"."purchase_order"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL) OR "equipment"."purchase_order"."status" = 'cancelled'

purchase_order_approved_at_shape.name: purchase_order_approved_at_shape
purchase_order_approved_at_shape.value: ("equipment"."purchase_order"."status" = 'draft' AND "equipment"."purchase_order"."approved_at" IS NULL) OR ("equipment"."purchase_order"."status" IN ('approved', 'sent') AND "equipment"."purchase_order"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL) OR "equipment"."purchase_order"."status" = 'cancelled'

quote_work_items_name_shape.name: quote_work_items_name_shape

quote_cancellation_reason_shape.name: quote_cancellation_reason_shape
quote_cancellation_reason_shape.value:
(
        "equipment"."quote"."status" = 'cancelled'
        and "equipment"."quote"."cancellation_reason" is not null
        and length(trim("equipment"."quote"."cancellation_reason")) > 0
      ) or (
        "equipment"."quote"."status" <> 'cancelled'
        and "equipment"."quote"."cancellation_reason" is null
      )

quote_kind_shape.name: quote_kind_shape

stock_movement_shape.name: stock_movement_shape
stock_movement_shape.value:
(
        "equipment"."stock_movement"."movement_type" = 'adjustment'
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."job_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."purchase_order_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."build_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."reason" IN ('opening-balance', 'stock-count', 'damage', 'scrap', 'correction')
        AND ("equipment"."stock_movement"."stocktake_session_id" IS NULL OR "equipment"."stock_movement"."reason" = 'stock-count')
        AND (
          "equipment"."stock_movement"."reason" = 'opening-balance'
          OR "equipment"."stock_movement"."stocktake_session_id" IS NOT NULL
          OR "equipment"."stock_movement"."note" IS NOT NULL
        )
        AND ("equipment"."stock_movement"."unit_cost" IS NULL OR "equipment"."stock_movement"."reason" = 'opening-balance')
      ) OR (
        "equipment"."stock_movement"."movement_type" = 'revaluation'
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."job_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."purchase_order_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."build_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."stocktake_session_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."delta" = 0
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."unit_cost" IS NOT NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."reason" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "equipment"."stock_movement"."movement_type" = 'checkout'
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."job_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."purchase_order_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."build_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."stocktake_session_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."delta" < 0
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."reason" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "equipment"."stock_movement"."movement_type" = 'return-to-store'
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."job_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."purchase_order_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."build_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."stocktake_session_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."delta" > 0
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."reason" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "equipment"."stock_movement"."movement_type" = 'receipt'
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."job_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."purchase_order_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."build_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."stocktake_session_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."delta" > 0
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."reason" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."unit_cost" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "equipment"."stock_movement"."movement_type" = 'return-to-supplier'
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."job_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."purchase_order_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."build_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."stocktake_session_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."delta" < 0
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."reason" IN ('wrong-item', 'defective', 'order-error')
      ) OR (
        "equipment"."stock_movement"."movement_type" = 'build-consume'
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."job_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."purchase_order_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."build_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."stocktake_session_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."delta" < 0
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."reason" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "equipment"."stock_movement"."movement_type" = 'build-produce'
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."job_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."purchase_order_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."build_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."stocktake_session_id" IS NULL
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."delta" > 0
        AND "equipment"."stock_movement"."reason" IS NULL
      )
